about: Hand-written expectations for #88 (tests/test_issue88_total_lag.py and tools/qualify_total_lag.py). Invented incidents of two records each, seven paths: A>B 30 passages of 10 h, B>C 20 of 1 h, C>D 2 of 50 h, D>E 1 of 60 h (the rare long path), E>F 10 of 5 h, F>G 5 of 2 h, G>H 3 of 30 h. The total time on a path is the sum of its lags. Never read by product code.
